declared_capabilities.codegen_tool: Nova can generate code from specifications with preview-only safety constraints
declared_capabilities.codegen_patch_bridge: Nova can convert codegen previews into formal patch artifacts compatible with patch queue
declared_capabilities.capability_gap_detection: Nova can detect gaps between desired capabilities (roadmap) and registered capabilities

declared_capabilities.leah_voice_persona_engine: Leah can speak with a stable voice persona and response style

declared_capabilities.leah_conversation_continuity: Leah can maintain continuity across turns and sessions
declared_capabilities.dependency_resolution: Nova can analyze and resolve missing external package dependencies
declared_capabilities.type_checking: Nova can perform static type checking and linting on generated code
declared_capabilities.api_gateway: Nova can expose generated code through HTTP API endpoints
declared_capabilities.database_schema_generation: Nova can generate database schema and migration code
declared_capabilities.configuration_management: Nova can generate configuration schemas and validation
declared_capabilities.documentation_generation: Nova can generate API documentation from generated code

declared_capabilities.performance_profiling: Nova can profile and optimize generated code performance
declared_capabilities.security_scanning: Nova can scan generated code for security vulnerabilities
declared_capabilities.deployment_automation: Nova can generate deployment and infrastructure-as-code artifacts
declared_capabilities.rollback_management: Nova can generate safe rollback procedures for generated changes
